name: How long does professional drywall finishing typically take for a standard room?

mainEntity.name: How long does professional drywall finishing typically take for a standard room?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration for professional drywall finishing depends on the room size, the condition of the drywall installation, and the desired finish level. For a standard room (e.g., 10x12 feet) with Level 4 or 5 finishing, it typically takes 3 to 5 days. This includes time for applying multiple coats of joint compound, drying between coats, and sanding. Larger rooms or those requiring extensive repairs will naturally take longer, while smaller areas might be completed faster. Weather conditions, especially humidity, can also impact drying times.
acceptedAnswer.description: For a standard room, professional drywall finishing usually takes 3 to 5 days, depending on size, drywall condition, and the desired finish level, allowing for multiple coats and drying times.
